item.blurb: Intellivisa Raises $3M Pre-seed. Intellivisa raises $3 million in pre-seed funding led by Mu Ventures and Incisive Ventures to scale its AI travel authorization engine.
Affinity Labs Raises $2M Pre-seed. Affinity Labs raises $2M in pre-seed funding led by Fuel Ventures to expand its portfolio of AI-powered software brands built with content creators.
Dapta Raises $6M Seed. Dapta raises $6M in Seed funding led by Chingona Ventures to accelerate its AI sales agent platform expansion across the U.S. and Latin America.
Lightsprint Raises $6.1M Seed. Lightsprint raises $6.1M in seed funding led by 645 Ventures to expand its platform enabling non-engineers to ship code changes safely.
Reach Security Raises $50M Series B. Reach Security raises $50M in Series B funding led by Top Tier Capital Partners to advance its AI-powered security control validation platform.
Albert Raises $55M Series B. Albert raises $55M in Series B funding led by TCV to scale its chemistry-native AI operating system for enterprise research and development.

How I Learned That Some Startup Problems Are Too Big For A Minimum Viable Product. Complex, interconnected problems like compliance require a comprehensive product from the outset, argues guest columnist Daniel Kjellén, CEO and co-founder of Freda. Drawing on his experience selling Tink, he explains how repeat founders can combine capital, credibility and hard-earned lessons with AI’s development speed to pursue bigger ambitions without shrinking their vision.
